newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola falls on hedges, commercials, CBOT.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola falls on hedges, commercials, CBOT.

text.p: WCE canola futures slipped to lower closes on hedges, commercial selling and lower CBOT soycomplex values, traders said.

"There was hedge selling from $435.70 to $435.10 met by commercial short covering every 50 cents down -- Pioneer and it's thought to be Manitoba Pool, were hedging," a trader said. Jan-Mar spread at $1, Nov-Jan 4.90. UGG was a noted seller of January. Crush margins rose about C$1.50.
November canola fell $3 to $433.60, January fell $2.50 to $438. One hundred November flax fell $1.50 to $370.50 on commercial selling, 25 hedges.
Commercials sold 20 December oats down US$4.50 to US$125.

October feed wheat fell the $5 limit to $200.90 on ideas weekend frost may boost the amount of wheat grading as feed wheat. December fell $4.50 to $185.50. Oct-Dec spread at $14, Dec-Mar $5. Volume was 1,200 lots.
November western barley lost $2.10 to $147, February down $1.80 to $151.70 on commercials, Alberta Wheat Pool was a scale down buyer of both months, traders said. Volume was 1,125 lots.
XCan sold 55 December feed peas down US$1.30 to US$209.70 to UGG and LFG, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
